title.en: Grout names the sections; concrete pump main cylinder seal 90×140 keeps the printed cells
title.zh: 《灌浆》只提供章节，concrete pump main cylinder seal 90×140仍用已印格子

description.en: The concrete pump main cylinder seal 90×140 note follows the outline of Grout. The 90×140 main-cylinder seal is one set on the Xingtai main-cylinder seal page. The full mark list is φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. This note is only 90×140.
description.zh: concrete pump main cylinder seal 90×140这篇笔记顺着《灌浆》的大纲写。90×140 主油缸密封是邢台主油缸密封页上的一套。全部标记是 φ63、φ80、80×125、90×140、90–160、95×140、100×150 和 461K。本文只写 90×140。

h1.en: How Grout arranges a note that only repeats concrete pump main cylinder seal 90×140
h1.zh: 《灌浆》怎样安排一篇只重复concrete pump main cylinder seal 90×140的笔记

directAnswer.en: For concrete pump main cylinder seal 90×140, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Grout. Grout only lends its headings. The 90×140 main-cylinder seal is one set on the Xingtai main-cylinder seal page. The full mark list is φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. This note is only 90×140.
directAnswer.zh: 写concrete pump main cylinder seal 90×140时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《灌浆》借数字。《灌浆》只出借标题。 90×140 主油缸密封是邢台主油缸密封页上的一套。全部标记是 φ63、φ80、80×125、90×140、90–160、95×140、100×150 和 461K。本文只写 90×140。

heading.zh: 来源章节：Grout vs mortar and caulk

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Grout vs mortar and caulk” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. 90×140 is a two-number mark on the main-cylinder seal kit. Unit: set. Material is not printed. Service life is not printed. The page tells the buyer to confirm the kit against the cylinder bore and rod. It does not define which of the two numbers is the bore. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Some pump pages name a hydraulic pump such as a Kawasaki unit. That cell is not this seal kit, and it is not a spare-part page for a hydraulic pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Copy the mark as 90×140. Do not normalise 90–160 into 90×160, and do not turn 461K into a diameter. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “来源章节：Grout vs mortar and caulk”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 90×140 是主油缸密封套件上的两组数字的标记。单位：套。材料没有印。寿命没有印。 页面要求对照油缸缸径和活塞杆核对套件。它没有规定两个数字里哪一个是缸径。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 有的泵页写了川崎等液压泵。那一格不是这套密封，也不是液压泵的配件页。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 标记按 90×140 原文抄。不要把 90–160 规范成 90×160，也不要把 461K 改成直径。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

heading.zh: 来源章节：Cementitious tile grouts classification

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Cementitious tile grouts classification”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. The 90×140 main-cylinder seal is one set on the Xingtai main-cylinder seal page. The full mark list is φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. This note is only 90×140. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 来源页在“来源章节：Cementitious tile grouts classification”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 90×140 主油缸密封是邢台主油缸密封页上的一套。全部标记是 φ63、φ80、80×125、90×140、90–160、95×140、100×150 和 461K。本文只写 90×140。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Varieties”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“来源章节：Varieties”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: The heading “Tools and treatments” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 主油缸密封 page plus this size and the quantity. The outline does not complete a blank. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grout
body.zh: 标题“来源章节：Tools and treatments”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明主油缸密封这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 大纲补不上空白格子。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grout

question.en: Does “Cementitious tile grouts classification” on Grout fill a blank on the concrete pump main cylinder seal 90×140 row?
question.zh: 《灌浆》上的“来源章节：Cementitious tile grouts classification”会填上concrete pump main cylinder seal 90×140的空白格子吗？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
